  "blacklist usb_storage" \

lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "usb_storage not loaded (confirmed)"

echo "STEP3: confirm modprobe would refuse to load it"

sudo -n modprobe -c 2>/dev/null | grep -A0 "^blacklist usb_storage" || true
echo "modprobe config check:"
modprobe --showconfig 2>/dev/null | grep usb_storage || true

echo "STEP4: attempt explicit load to prove install /bin/false blocks it"
sudo -n modprobe usb_storage; echo "modprobe exit=$?"
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "still not loaded after modprobe attempt (confirmed blocked)"
